audit.whatIsWrong: Three stages read 'Skill' (Level 1, Levels 4-5, Level 6) even though all seven whys begin with the words 'Tryndamere-favoured', and breakdown.spikes claimed Level 6, First item and 2+ items as YOUR windows against a chart that gives you none of them.
audit.why: The packet levelChart gives Tryndamere all seven stages and the Emerald+ win rate is 49.71% — Mundo is the losing side here. Nothing in the entry's own prose argues for an even stage.
audit.corrected: Tryndamere favoured at every stage; the spike calendar now says you have no lane window and plays for two HP items plus Grievous Wounds. Submitted as one atomic chart group across content win[] and full phases[].side/.rating.

audit.whatIsWrong: Undying Rage was listed at 110 seconds in both breakdown.cooldowns and report[5].t. It is 120/100/80.
audit.why: Riot data: Tryndamere R 120/100/80, 400 range. The rank-1 number is what matters in lane, and it is 120 — a full 10 seconds longer than the page claimed, which changes every 'wait it out' call.
audit.corrected: Both blocks now read 120s at rank 1, 80s maxed.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[1].text called Undying Rage 'uncatchable for 5 seconds' — it does not grant mobility or immunity to damage, it prevents death. Mocking Shout was never mentioned anywhere despite being the ability that decides whether you can leave a trade. phases[2].why also claimed 'your passive shrugs the first CC' when Tryndamere has no immobilizing effect at all.
audit.why: Riot text: Undying Rage — he is unable to die. Mocking Shout, 850 range, 14s, reduces surrounding champions' attack damage and slows only enemies whose backs are turned to him. Spinning Slash 650 range, 12/11/10/9/8. Nothing in his kit immobilises, so Goes Where He Pleases is never spent in this lane.
audit.corrected: 'Uncatchable' replaced with unkillable-not-untouchable; Mocking Shout's back-turned slow written into wants.you[2] as the reason never to walk away facing forward; the canister is stated as staying banked.

audit.why: wants.you[1] already buys Bramble Vest / Executioner's against Bloodlust, which is the right call — Bloodlust is his only sustain and it is a Fury-consuming heal on a 12s cooldown.

edits.after: See the level-by-level chart — Tryndamere is favoured at every stage; your play is Grievous Wounds and refusing the duel.
